# Round-trip trading costs for the model's paper strategy (scripts/model_backtest.py; docs/DESIGN.md
# section 15). Research only: no trade is ever placed. Rates are fractions of traded value. Every value
# is marked "verify": check it against the official source before relying on it. Looked up on
# 2026-10-06/07. Each line says what backs it:
#   ASSUMPTION      a broker choice, not a published rate; no source.
#   OFFICIAL, READ  read on the official page named (sec.gov, finra.org).
#   SEARCH ONLY     the official site (nseindia.com, sebi.gov.in, incometaxindia.gov.in, cbic.gov.in,
#                   ccilindia.com) refused this environment's traffic, so the value comes from
#                   web-search results quoting it; the official URL given was NOT opened.
# The backtest applies these rates to every past date (earlier dates had other rates, e.g. the SEC fee was
# $0 per million until 2026-04-03 per the advisory below).
# Not modelled: bid-ask spread and slippage (fills assumed at the official open and close prices; set
# slippage_each_side to stress-test), and India's flat DP charge per scrip sold (a rupee amount per sale,
# not a rate; it depends on position size).
india:
  # Equity delivery (the holds span at least one night, so delivery rates apply, not intraday).
  brokerage_each_side: 0.0          # verify. ASSUMPTION: a discount broker charging Rs 0 on delivery trades
  stt_each_side: 0.001              # verify. SEARCH ONLY: STT 0.1% on delivery purchase and sale (Finance (No. 2)
                                    # Act 2004, Chapter VII); official page not opened: https://incometaxindia.gov.in
  exchange_txn_each_side: 0.0000307 # verify. SEARCH ONLY: NSE cash market 0.00307% from 2026-03-01 (0.00297%
                                    # 2024-10-01..2026-02-28), NSE circular of 2026-02-27; nseindia.com was
                                    # unreachable, so this rate comes from search results, the circular was not
                                    # opened: https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FA73061.pdf
  sebi_fee_each_side: 0.000001      # verify. SEARCH ONLY: SEBI turnover fee Rs 10 per crore = 0.0001%; official
                                    # document not opened: https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/meetingfiles/jul-2020/1594293677017_1.pdf
  stamp_duty_buy: 0.00015           # verify. SEARCH ONLY: 0.015% on the buy side of a delivery transfer, Indian Stamp
                                    # Act 1899 Schedule I Article 56A as amended by the Finance Act 2019, in force
                                    # 2020-07-01; official page not opened: https://www.ccilindia.com/web/ccil/tr-stamp-duty
  gst_rate: 0.18                    # verify. SEARCH ONLY: GST 18% on brokerage + exchange transaction + SEBI fees
                                    # (SAC 997152); no official CBIC page was found or opened
  slippage_each_side: 0.0
us:
  commission_each_side: 0.0         # verify. ASSUMPTION: a commission-free broker
  sec_fee_sell: 0.0000206           # verify. OFFICIAL, READ: Section 31 fee $20.60 per million on sales from
                                    # 2026-04-04 ($0.00 before): https://www.sec.gov/rules-regulations/fee-rate-advisories/2026-2
  # FINRA TAF on sales of covered equity securities. OFFICIAL, READ (FINRA's own filing, opened 2026-10-07):
  # SR-FINRA-2026-021 pauses the TAF at $0.00 per share, max $0.00, from 2026-10-01 through 2026-12-31; the rate
  # it replaces, which resumes 2027-01-01, is $0.000195 per share, max $9.79 per trade (Exhibit 5):
  # https://www.finra.org/sites/default/files/2026-09/SR-FINRA-2026-021.pdf
  # Below: the rate in force on 2026-10-07 ($0).
  finra_taf_per_share_sell: 0.0     # verify (0.000195 from 2027-01-01)
  finra_taf_max_per_trade: 0.0      # verify (9.79 from 2027-01-01)
  notional_per_trade: 10000.0       # USD per position, only for the per-share TAF and its cap
  slippage_each_side: 0.0
